research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Inflammatix is researching systems and methods for deriving and optimizing classifiers from multiple modules to evaluate clinical conditions, including assessing bacterial or viral status of a sample and diagnosis of respiratory viral infections. It develops a fluidic device and fluidic methods for processing biological samples and characterizing infection, isothermal amplification based diagnosis and treatment of acute infection, and gene expression based diagnostics for myocardial infarction and inflammatory bowel disease, covering infection, inflammation, and cardiac events.

overview_description.description:
Inflammatix develops novel molecular diagnostics for acute infections and sepsis that work by 'reading' the immune system.  It is a molecular diagnostics company developing rapid tests that read the immune system to resolve major clinical and public health challenges.

They are initially focused on developing tests for acute bacterial and viral infections, and sepsis based on patent-pending biomarkers exclusively licensed from Stanford University.
